question: Indian boxer ________ (48 kg) was one of the gold medal winners at the 73rd Strandja Memorial Boxing Tournament, held in Sofia, Bulgaria in February 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitu Ghanghas.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitu Ghanghas is an Indian boxer (48 kg) and was one of the gold medal winners at the 73rd Strandja Memorial Boxing Tournament, held in Sofia, Bulgaria in February 2022.**
 
• **Nitu (48 kg) prevailed 5-0 over Italy's Erika Prisciandaro, a former youth world championship bronze-medallist.**
 
• **Nikhat Zareen:**
 
 
• Indian boxer Nikhat Zareen won a gold medal in the** 52kg category at the 73rd Strandja Memorial Tournament in Sofia, Bulgaria on 27 Feb 2022, by defeating Ukraine's Tetiana Kob.**
 
• She has become the** 1st Indian boxer to win 2 gold medals at Strandja Memorial Boxing.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manju Rani:**

 
 
• She won in the** 48kg light flyweight category defeating Russia's Ekaterina Paltceva to win the silver medal.**
 
• Manju Rani became the first Indian boxer after **18 years to reach the finals on debut**.
